title: Resource Management Lifecycle: Strict Mode to Global Quotas
mini_srs: This milestone implements the full resource management lifecycle for Qdrant's strict mode and global quota system. It begins with d75d805 adding max_disk_usage_percent to strict mode in collections.proto (field 22 on StrictModeConfig) with validation range 1-100 and conversions in conversions.rs. Commit c34acc1 supersedes it with a node-wide QuotaConfig API: it creates quota_internal.proto with GetQuotaUsage RPC and QuotaUsage message, adds the RPC to qdrant_internal_service.proto, removes field 22 (reserved) from StrictModeConfig, and deprecates max_resident_memory_percent (field 21). The Python client 1.19.0 model sync (589aece) regenerates gRPC stubs and REST models across 29 files bringing both fields into the client. Finally da58e7d completes the cycle by removing max_disk_usage_percent from conversion.py GrpcToRest/RestToGrpc paths and HTTP models, deprecating max_resident_memory_percent in the REST schema, and regenerating all stubs.
expansion_rationale: Hard xrepo edges c34acc1->da58e7d (conf 1.0) and d75d805->da58e7d (conf 0.85) mandate cross-repo grouping per the rule that contract changes must not be split from their first consumer. Path completeness requires 589aece as intermediary on the enforced path d75d805->589aece(xrepo)->da58e7d(textual via conversion.py line 2677 and collections_pb2.py). Patches confirm: d75d805 adds field 22 to StrictModeConfig in collections.proto:450; c34acc1 reserves field 22 and creates quota_internal.proto with QuotaUsage message; da58e7d removes max_disk_usage_percent from conversion.py:2677-2679 and models.py. PR #10035 (c34acc1) documents the architectural motivation for moving per-collection strict mode to node-wide quotas.

title: Fix Stale Snapshot Transfer Breaking Cluster
mini_srs: This milestone fixes a cluster-breaking bug where stale shard transfer requests replayed after a sender restart could wipe a receiver's shard data and put it into a crash loop. It adds optional from_peer_id validation fields to InitiateShardTransferRequest in collections_internal_service.proto and RecoverShardSnapshotRequest in shard_snapshots_service.proto so the receiver rejects transfers from unregistered peers. The fix also makes dummy shard un-proxification return without error instead of triggering a fatal service error that stops consensus. Verified by testing that only the registered source may clear a shard for snapshot recovery.
expansion_rationale: 7477c7c is a standalone layer-0 commit with 0 ancestors and 31 descendants (all through the 589aece mega-sync in qdrant-client which belongs to another milestone). Patch shows +10 lines across 3 files: collections_internal_service.proto:39 adds optional uint64 from_peer_id to InitiateShardTransferRequest; shard_snapshots_service.proto:52 adds optional uint64 from_peer_id to RecoverShardSnapshotRequest; qdrant.rs adds corresponding struct fields. PR #10643 documents the incident scenario. No additional commits found modifying these internal service proto messages.
